text: The underwriting use case is broader than traditional insurance: almost any blockchain transaction that does not consist purely of an exchange of digital tokens may require or benefit from underwriting.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vadhindran K. Rao, Decentralized Underwriting (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3396542
abstract: In fact, almost any transaction on the blockchain that does not involve an exchange of purely digital tokens may require or benefit from underwriting.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: blockchain transactions involving non digital assets or performance
